outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single representative pseudocoloured images for each construct (H1.1, RCC1, H1t) from a photoactivation time-lapse, implying these are typical/representative of a larger set of cells or experiments. The caption never states how many cells, nuclei, or independent experiments these images represent, nor the type of replicate, so the reliability/representativeness of the shown data cannot be assessed.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B explicitly presents averaged data (inset 'average early time points responses') with error bars/spread across data points, indicating pooling of multiple measurements. However, neither the caption nor the panel states how many cells, nuclei, or independent experiments were averaged, nor the type of replicate (e.g., independent experiments, biological replicates, number of cells), so replication cannot be verified.
